A [[Gender/Legends|female]] senior '''aide''' worked for [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] during her [[Time/Legends|time]] as [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="RA" /> a position she served in from approximately [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] states that Mon Mothma was elected [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] shortly after the signing of the [[Corellian Treaty]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. The latter text additionally dates the transition of the Alliance into the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], and therefore the end of Mothma's tenure as its Chief of State, to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Mothma incorrectly suspected the female [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of being a member of [[Security]], a branch of the Alliance's [[Counter-Intelligence]] that [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on other Alliance departments. The Chief of State did not reveal her suspicions, and in actuality, two of Mothma's other aides were Security operatives.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mon Mothma's aide was first mentioned in the [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|second edition]] of ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', published in [[1994]] with revisions by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]].<ref name="RA" />
